title: GitHub Copilot for JetBrains 1.1.23.1570
body_markdown:
* Added compatibility with 2022.2 EAP
* Terminate the GitHub Copilot helper process when the IDE quits
* Fixed exception `Cyclic service initialization`
* Support more color scheme text attributes for the GitHub Copilot editor inlay hints
